title: Shared RLS for reports and AI
assumptions: Source-pinned simplification of commit 84b9d80a92035ace1889be904d09e46ea9480111; no API, authentication or model changes.
Zones represent logical ownership, not network or deployment boundaries.
Legend: solid calls = query/control; dashed carriers = identity/tokens. No data-movement or reference edges are specified.
Optional inference footnote: portal Azure OpenAI Responses uses a separate gateway Azure identity; inference is outside the Fabric query flow.
Specific REST/authentication documentation governs; no general AAC diagram is adopted. No production, tenant-isolation, OLS or GA claims are made.
evidence_gaps: Deployment tenant, workspace Admin, certificate and scope-grant configuration have not been validated.
Delegated metadata consent and the optional inference credential mechanism are unspecified.
Reference guidance remains cached at 6c11ad58c25992e5d1435ce7cd80d217d5598a31; refresh was blocked by an unrelated dirty checkout.
Fabric blog coverage was blocked by HTTP 403.

nodes.label:
Application + AI clients
App JWT
nodes.notes: Portal /api/chat invokes shared tools in-process, not through self-HTTP MCP. External MCP agents call /mcp.

nodes.label:
Power BI
Embedded report
nodes.notes: Browser report queries the same semantic model and exact grants as AI. The backend SPN bearer is never sent to the browser.

nodes.label:
Trusted application identity
Validated sub -> userKey
Fixed role + model
nodes.notes: Validate app JWT issuer, audience, signature and lifetime. Map trusted sub server-side to opaque userKey, fixed role and configured model. Clients and AI cannot select key, role or model.

nodes.label:
Custom gateway tools
get_semantic_model_schema
search_values + execute_dax
nodes.notes: Both custom search_values and execute_dax use the shared Power BI REST executeDaxQueries path.

nodes.label:
Entra service principal
Certificate-backed
nodes.notes: Query/embed identity lane: certificate-authenticated backend SPN OAuth bearer, distinct from the app JWT and embed token.

nodes.label:
Report embedding
Same bound userKey + role
nodes.notes: Embed-config route: /api/embed, not /api/embed-config. Effective identity binds username and customData to userKey, with the fixed role and configured dataset.

nodes.label:
Native Fabric IQ MCP
GetSemanticModelSchema
(artifactId)
nodes.notes: Metadata-only identity lane: delegated metadata-account OAuth, never SPN/app-only. Filtered cached schema is shared, not per-user OLS. Native ExecuteQuery and ValueSearch are not used.

nodes.label:
Power BI REST
executeDaxQueries
nodes.notes: customData is a request-body field, not an OAuth claim. Role-bearing SPN queries require workspace Admin.

nodes.label:
Power BI REST
GenerateToken
nodes.notes: The same backend SPN authenticates GenerateToken. Token issuance is not a data query.

nodes.label:
Semantic Model
RLS: CUSTOMDATA()
Exact user-key / scope grants
nodes.notes: The model role evaluates CUSTOMDATA() as the opaque userKey against exact scope grants.
